app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.
RCA_gt: A Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos experiment injects `99%` packet loss with `100%` correlation into one pod selected by the `user` service label for `900s` (15 minutes). The root cause is the injected network loss on the Hotel Reservation `user` service, which makes calls to that service fail or time out.
_source_comment: Ground truth source: AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/network_loss/network_loss.py (faulty_service and 200s duration); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/generators/fault/inject_symp.py (NetworkChaos loss, correlation, and mode); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/registry.py (problem ID).
